fixers.name: Mr. Cipher
fixers.teaser: Finish the roster. Then we talk scope.

vexGraduation.subject: TRAINING // cleared for live scope
body: Ghost. You cleared the sim: navigation, port scan, credential attack, trace thresholds.
You are not my student anymore. I do not broker paid work.
Relay handles contracts from here. Stay in scope. Document what you touch.

vexRelayIntro.subject: HANDOFF // Relay
body: Vex forwarded your handle. I broker breach-and-retrieve and recon gigs for clients who want results, not drama.
Every job has written scope. Out-of-bounds hosts spike SOC correlation and cost you Standing with me.
Check JOBS on the board. First set is basic: edge survey, exfil, log triage. Operator Rank tracks your Street Cred.
Core verbs: help 3 (network), help 4 (crackers), help 5 (firewalls). hints auto unless you change it.

relaySetComplete.subject: SET // acknowledged
body: Set closed. Your Standing with me moved. Next hub visit I will seed harder scope.
Keep heat under control at exfil if you want the stealth payout bonus.
